The current saved PUE (Power Usage Effectiveness) for the Kajaani design is 1.25.

Kajaani, Kainuu, Finland is proposed as the main design case, with comparisons planned for Québec, Canada and Singapore.

LUMI is located in Kajaani and provides an existing example of warm-water cooling and heat recovery. [S1]

The LUMI example does not establish grid capacity, water supply, fiber routes, or cooling performance specifics for the proposed new data center facility in Kajaani. [S1]

answers.answer:
The saved PUE is 1.4 as a proposed design assumption for the Kajaani facility.

The facility power is calculated at 28 MW by multiplying the IT load of 20 MW by the PUE of 1.4.

The annual energy consumption is calculated as 245.28 GWh based on a constant load over 8760 hours per year with a 28 MW facility power.

The Kajaani, Kainuu, Finland site is used as the main design case for this project, with comparisons to Québec, Canada and Singapore.

Strong seasonal variation in Finland requires both winter freeze protection and summer cooling assessment; the national climate context does not establish design weather at the proposed site. [S18]

Equatorial climate in Singapore has high temperatures and humidity throughout the year, which implies different cooling constraints but does not determine facility PUE. [S19]

Eligible academic use of the Kajaani facility may be free of charge under the CSC policy, subject to user account and project allocation availability and suitability, which remain unknown. [S17]

Canadian climate normals data is available from 1991 to 2020, but a precise Québec site for the design has not been selected and design temperatures remain unknown. [S23]
assumptions: The saved PUE is 1.4 as a proposed design assumption for the Kajaani facility.
calculations: The facility power is calculated at 28 MW by multiplying the IT load of 20 MW by the PUE of 1.4.
The annual energy consumption is calculated as 245.28 GWh based on a constant load over 8760 hours per year with a 28 MW facility power.
design_decisions: The Kajaani, Kainuu, Finland site is used as the main design case for this project, with comparisons to Québec, Canada and Singapore.

answers.answer:
In the base case with 25% utilization, the lowest resource NPV option is the hybrid model with approximately EUR 889 million.

In the half-utilization case with 12.5% productive utilization, the lowest resource NPV option is the lease model with approximately EUR 535 million.

The cloud reference price is USD 3.99 per billed GPU-hour, published by Lambda, converted to EUR using an exchange rate assumption of 0.92 EUR/USD. [S14]

The facility EUR 10 million per IT MW for land, building, power, UPS, generators and cooling is an unquoted planning allowance, excluding GPU fleet and utility upgrades.

The full-build grid upgrade cost of EUR 15 million is an unquoted placeholder with actual utility offer unknown.

The installed IT cost per GPU of EUR 40,000 is an unquoted allowance including GPU, host, fabric and storage, with deployment included.

The delivered electricity tariff of EUR 0.10 per kWh is an unquoted planning assumption, not derived from a verified site-specific tariff quote. [S16]

Other cost assumptions include IT replacement intervals, maintenance fractions, staffing, cloud administrative costs, discount rates, and financing parameters—all unverified and used for planning only.

No verified site procurement quotes for the facility, grid, IT equipment, or utilities are available for this design.

The full-build grid upgrade cost of EUR 15 million is an unquoted placeholder with actual utility offer unknown.
The installed IT cost per GPU of EUR 40,000 is an unquoted allowance including GPU, host, fabric and storage, with deployment included.
The delivered electricity tariff of EUR 0.10 per kWh is an unquoted planning assumption, not derived from a verified site-specific tariff quote. [S16]

Other cost assumptions include IT replacement intervals, maintenance fractions, staffing, cloud administrative costs, discount rates, and financing parameters—all unverified and used for planning only.
